title: boechera rollei
intro: Boechera rollei, commonly known as Rock Cress, is a plant species in the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The plant's therapeutic actions include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Boechera rollei include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal effects and have been shown to have potential in cancer prevention and treatment.
